description: Scan a multi-page user journey. Walks startUrl plus the `autoNavigate` URLs sequentially (deterministic — one page fully rendered and scanned before the next), then returns ONE consolidated report with issues deduplicated across pages, each carrying the same fix payload as scan_page. Every requested URL gets an explicit outcome in `pages[]` (scanned / nav_failed / scan_failed / redirected_duplicate / duplicate_request / skipped_cap / blocked — bot-challenge, not a clean page / auth_redirect — storageState was given but the page is a sign-in page, session likely expired) — a page is never silently dropped. It only visits URLs: it does not click, type or log in. For pages behind a login, pass `storageState` (local MCP only), a session file saved after logging in once. Without `autoNavigate` it scans only startUrl, exactly like scan_page.

autoNavigate.description: The URLs to walk after startUrl, in order (the MCP server is headless and cannot discover a journey interactively). Omit or pass [] to scan only startUrl as a single page.

format.description: "compact" prints one line per element with rule metadata once. "json" returns every field (html, fix values, source). Default: JSON when it fits inline (under ~24k chars), otherwise compact plus a JSON summary of every count. On the hosted server the default is compact.

level.description: Highest WCAG conformance level to report. Default "AA" — Level AAA criteria are not reported. Pass "AAA" to include them (naming one AAA criterion in `wcag`, e.g. "3.2.5", also includes it).

maxPages.description: Max pages to scan (default 10; at most 10 on the hosted server)

minImpact.description: Only findings at this severity or above (critical > serious > moderate > minor)

offset.description: Start the issue list at this index of the severity-sorted entries. The response carries `nextOffset` when more remain; pass it to read the next page. Default 0. Each call scans the page again, so on a live page the list can shift between calls; treat the offset as a position, not a snapshot.

rules.description: Only these rule ids (WebAbility type such as "missing_alt" or axe rule id such as "image-alt"). See get_rules.

sourceRoot.description: Local project root (local installs only) for `sourceCandidates[]` on issues without a framework `source` pointer.

storageState.description: Local MCP only. Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON file (cookies + localStorage) for pages behind a login. Make one by logging in once: `npx @webability/cli flow <login-url> --save-storage-state auth.json`. The hosted server refuses this argument.

wcag.description: Only these WCAG criteria. A prefix selects the whole guideline ("1.4") or principle ("2").

name: flow_scan
title: Scan a multi-page user flow
